title: Module Assessment: Advanced OOP (PY_201 to PY_208)

slides.title: Module 1 Overview
slides.prompt: Assessment covering Magic Methods, ABCs, MRO, Mixins, Descriptors, Slots, and Metaclasses.

slides.title: Question 1: Subscript Access
slides.prompt: Which magic method allows indexing via `obj[key]`?

slides.title: Question 2: ABC Instantiation
slides.prompt: What error occurs when instantiating an ABC with unimplemented `@abstractmethod`?

slides.title: Question 3: MRO Algorithm
slides.prompt: Which algorithm resolves Python's Method Resolution Order (MRO)?

slides.title: Question 4: String Representation
slides.prompt: Fill in the method returning an official developer-focused string representation.

slides.title: Question 5: Mixin Pattern
slides.prompt: What is a core best practice for Mixin classes?

slides.title: Question 6: Descriptor Priority
slides.prompt: Which component has the highest priority during attribute lookup?

slides.title: Question 7: Memory Slots
slides.prompt: Fill in the attribute used to prevent `__dict__` creation for memory optimization.

slides.title: Question 8: Metaclass Creation
slides.prompt: When is a metaclass `__new__` method invoked?

slides.title: Question 9: Dynamic Property
slides.prompt: Which built-in decorator turns a method into a read-only attribute descriptor?

slides.title: Question 10: Comparison Magic Method
slides.prompt: Fill in the method used to customize the equality (`==`) operator.

slides.title: Question 11: Class Method Binding
slides.prompt: What is passed as the implicit first argument to a `@classmethod`?

slides.title: Question 12: Private Attributes
slides.prompt: What mechanism does Python use to transform `__privateVar` in classes?

slides.title: Question 13: Callable Objects
slides.prompt: Fill in the magic method that allows an instance to be called like a function `obj()`.
